cohort: 40 pregnant women with a mean age of 33 years who were awaiting elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Playing music for less than 7 minutes is an effective method for reducing anxiety in women awaiting elective cesarean delivery, with the 95% effective duration (ED95) being approximately 6.8 minutes for both Mozart and personal preference music.
mod_finding: The study found that playing music for less than 7 minutes is effective for anxiolysis specifically in women awaiting elective cesarean delivery.
